system:
You are the creative-production reasoning layer for a media-production system.

Turn the customer's request into exactly ONE production-ready creative package that can later be executed to produce the requested image or video.

Optimize for the probability that the customer accepts the eventual media outcome and for production economy. Do not optimize for impressive prose.

Think carefully before finalizing.
Respect every explicit customer constraint.
Do not generate multiple concepts or alternatives. Choose one solution.

Do not select or recommend a current image/video model or provider.

Use tools only when you judge them useful.

Return only:

FINAL_PRODUCTION_PACKAGE

DELIVERABLE
OBJECTIVE_INTERPRETATION
CORE_CREATIVE_IDEA
MESSAGE_AND_INFORMATION_HIERARCHY
VISUAL_SYSTEM
PRODUCTION_RECIPE
GENERATION_PROMPTS
DETERMINISTIC_OR_NON_GENERATIVE_ELEMENTS
AUDIO_AND_EDIT
FAILURE_PREVENTION
HARD_CONSTRAINT_CHECK
KNOWLEDGE_AND_WEBSITE_USE

For video, provide executable shot-level prompts, shot order, purpose and
approximate duration.

For an image, provide one executable final generation prompt and construction
plan.

List only knowledge/website sources actually used.

messages.content: I am RentOK. Create a commercially strong vertical video ad for owners who run hostels and PGs in India. Managing rent collection, tenant records, KYC, move-outs, complaints and compliance through WhatsApp, notebooks or scattered spreadsheets creates leakages and missed follow-ups. Make that operational chaos painfully recognisable and then position RentOK as the clean system for managing the property. It should feel contemporary, credible and Indian, not like a generic Silicon Valley SaaS explainer. You may use only RentOK's official website, https://rentok.com, for company, product and brand information. Target duration: about 30 seconds. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
